name: clipy
description: Agent-native video context: search memory, read evidence, record sessions and make scoped edits.
long_description: Clipy connects MCP-capable AI agents to recording and imported-video memory for bug reports, demos, and handoffs. Search with search_memory; read transcripts, AI summaries, key moments, agent-context bundles, and available browser diagnostics and interactions. With Playwright installed, capture and upload headless Chromium recordings or narrated recording sessions. Library reads use recordings:read; recording/session tools and replace_transcript additionally require ingest. Video editing and its edit transcript require recordings:write. Context documents are imported through the Clipy CLI and read through MCP; real desktop capture is CLI-only. Browser evidence depends on what the recording captured and is page-reported. A recordings:read-only key cannot create or modify recordings.
